caption: A car enters a tunnel on a sunny day, and the inside of the car dims until the overhead tunnel lights take over.

sa.check: The inside of the car dims.
The overhead tunnel lights take over.
The order is bright, dim, then tunnel-lit.

pc.expect: The light in the car drops as the entrance passes overhead and takes on the tunnel lamps' colour.
pc.fail: The car stays sunlit in the tunnel; or dims before the entrance; or the light stays white under coloured lamps.

pc.expect: The dimming happens at the entrance and holds inside.
pc.fail: The car brightens inside; or flickers with steady lamps; or dims and brightens randomly.

pc.expect: The car drives steadily and the lamps pass overhead in turn.
pc.fail: The car jumps position; or the lamps move; or the car stops with no cause.

pc.expect: Only the light changes; the interior's colours are the same under it.
pc.fail: The seats change colour rather than tint; or the dashboard changes; or the interior rearranges.
A second car appears inside; or the tunnel vanishes; or the car passes through the wall.
Objects move; or the windows change; or the tunnel changes shape.
